excerpts.author: nero_eth
excerpts.content:
This is great, thanks!
Seems like bugs in prysm and erigon?

```
Erigon (main @ 6540ff47): why does flush+commit grow from ms to minutes under consecutive 200M-gas / 12 MB blocks while the disk is idle, and why does an in-flight commit make Assemble Block fail outright instead of queueing? The subsequent 17-minute SYNCING + backward-download loop (1–10 min per 9–51 blocks) is the costlier half of the incident. Same class of issue as the msf-2 14:17 UTC stall on 2026-10-13.
Prysm: the local-build path consumed two full 8 s engine timeouts before taking the p2p bid at 8.06 s, which guarantees an orphan. A shorter deadline for the local payload before falling back to a remote bid would have saved the slot.
```

yes 🙂  the panda cli has access to the logs via clickhouse. But it's not super easy to query them,  as it's basically a log store for all devnets & clients.
but AI can figure it out and give you the correct slice 🙂

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
```
panda clickhouse query clickhouse-raw "
SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['container.name'] AS c, substring(Body,1,200) AS body
FROM external.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['network'] = 'glamsterdam-devnet-8'
  AND ResourceAttributes['host.name'] = 'nimbus-nethermind-1'
  AND Timestamp BETWEEN '2026-10-17 08:32:30' AND '2026-10-17 08:32:41'
  AND (Body LIKE '%skipping validator duties%' OR Body LIKE '%Rejected invalid block%')
ORDER BY Timestamp"
```
